title: Heat capture, following the pipe
alt: A face-on section that follows a pipe: warm water leaves the data hall's coolant unit, a plate heat exchanger hands the heat to a second loop, a heat pump lifts it (the pipe turns darker), a buffer tank holds it, and a buried pipe takes it to the pool hall next door, where it warms the water. Cooled water comes back along the bottom.

steps.caption: Warm water leaves the data hall carrying the servers' heat.
A plate heat exchanger passes the heat to a second, clean loop.
A heat pump lifts the water to a useful temperature.
A buffer tank holds the warm water until it is needed.
The warm water heats the pool next door.
Then it comes back cooled, and the loop starts again.
